title: I work at a restaurant
content: For the past 18 years I've worked at a restaurant in Mall World. It's next door to a Barber Shop (hey guys!) and across the hallway is a Boutique (hi ladies!) We must be close to the bottom because years ago there was a flood and the water never rescinded. Now there's a family of otters (protected wild life) and all sorts of plants and bugs (also protected wild life) that live in the restaurant. There's two patrons that have been sitting in their respective booths for as long as I can remember. They're both really cool and we all get along great. I stand behind the counter just chilling by the pie warmer most of the time. I mostly do the customer service side of things (front of house) but occasionally will unload trucks and help with inventory. The break room is kinda awful, but I've grown to love the energy. I have like, 2 or 3 coworkers total and I never see them go in there. Almost feels like my own spot but I know it isn't. I shouldn't talk about the menu too much. I can say we have millions of choices, including stuff you can't find anywhere else. There isn't much oversight except for The Wildlife Protection Guys. I'm not allowed to joke about eating the animals or bugs that live in the restaurant, certain dishes we can't serve, etc. We don't get a lot of customers. There's pretty much 0 foot traffic. Our customers are mostly regulars, including the guys from the Barber Shop and the ladies from the Boutique. I'm considering promoting more vegan dishes to get The Wildlife Protection Guys to come around more often. Because of the flooding, customers and staff have to carefully wade through knee deep water. TWPG are *extremely* protective of the restaurants wildlife. There's a hallway leading to what feels like bathrooms but it isn't bathrooms. The guys from the Barber Shop have a post set up in the hallway for whatever reason so I honestly don't ever bother going down there. I like my spot next to the pie warmer. The Barber Shop is cool. Bunch of guys doing whatever. I recently found out it was tiered. Some bugs from the restaurant got into the Barber Shop and traveled to the other levels. Not sure what The Wildlife Protection Guys are doing about it but I'm sure they're being proactive. The Boutique is a new addition. I helped the ladies break in and set up shop without dealing with a lease or mall management or anything. We honestly don't know who's in charge and the place was vacant anyway. They sell all sorts of stuff, I don't even know what most of it is, but I still shop there. It's well lit, well stocked, and management is awesome. They have burning coals lining the walls of the showroom and it's really cool. Smells great there too. One of the restaurants patrons is the owner of Keyboard World and Drapes. I have a discount card! The other patron is a widow. She told me she's had 8 husbands! She keeps all of her receipts on hand at all times, and I don't know why. I don't get along with my coworkers anymore. They went to different levels or whatever and opened up food stands. They were using inventory from the restaurant, conning The Barber Shop guys into working personal security for them, broke the widows heart, and pissed off the owner of Keyboard World and Drapes. But I promise no wildlife was hurt! The otters are fine! If you can find the restaurant, please come by. It's actually really peaceful there. I'll help you find something satisfying from the menu!!
